rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Guard yourselves by avoiding sins and performing acts of obedience.
rows.anchor: بترك المعاصي وفعل الطاعات

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Guard your families by requiring of them what you require of yourselves.
rows.anchor: بأن تأخذوهم بما تأخذون به أنفسكم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: A hadith urges a man to call his family to prayer, fasting, alms, and care for the poor, orphans, and neighbors, hoping they will join him in Paradise.
rows.anchor: ( 1212 ) ( رحم الله رجلا قال يا أهلاه صلاتكم صيامكم زكاتكم

rows.speaker: قيل
rows.claim: It is said that the person most severely punished on the Resurrection Day is one who was ignorant of his family.
rows.anchor: وقيل : إن أشد الناس عذابا يوم القيامة من جهل أهله

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: A reading has وأهلوكم, coordinated with the subject pronoun in قوا; the intervening material makes the coordination acceptable.
rows.anchor: وقرىء : ( وأهلوكم ) ، عطفا على واو { قوا } وحسن العطف للفاصل

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The coordination is not elliptical for telling families to guard themselves: the families are estimated alongside the addressed subject, yielding ‘you and your families guard yourselves.’
rows.anchor: ولكن المعطوف مقارن في التقدير للواو ، وأنفسكم واقع بعده

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: This is a kind of fire ignited only by people and stones, unlike ordinary fires ignited by firewood.
rows.anchor: نوعا من النار لا يتقد إلا بالناس والحجارة ، كما يتقد غيرها من النيران بالحطب

rows.speaker: ابن عباس
rows.claim: Ibn Abbas identifies the stones as sulfur, which becomes exceptionally hot when kindled.
rows.anchor: وعن ابن عباس رضي الله عنهما : هي حجارة الكبريت ، وهي أشد الأشياء حرا

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: A reading with ḍamma on the wāw means that the fire has fuel.
rows.anchor: وقرىء : ( وقودها ) بالضم ، أي ذو وقودها

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The angels guarding the fire are the nineteen zabāniya and their assistants.
rows.anchor: يعني الزبانية التسعة عشر وأعوانهم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The angels are massive and strong in body, or harsh and rough in action; they show no pity in executing God's commands and avenging His enemies.
rows.anchor: في أجرامهم غلظة وشدة ، أي : جفاء وقوة . أو في أفعالهم جفاء وخشونة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: ما أمرهم is accusative as an appositive, meaning they do not disobey what God commanded; it can also mean they do not disobey Him in what He commands.
rows.anchor: في محل النصب على البدل ، أي : لا يعصون ما أمر الله

words: لا يعصون الله ما أمرهم ويَفْعَلُونَ مَا يُؤْمَرُونَ
rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The first clause says the angels accept and commit to God's orders without refusal; the second says they execute them without reluctance or delay.
rows.anchor: فإن معنى الأولى أنهم يتقبلون أوامره ويلتزمونها ولا يأبونها ولا ينكرونها

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Although the fire is prepared for disbelievers, believers are warned because sinful believers occupy the same abode as them, even if their levels are higher.
rows.anchor: الفساق وإن كانت دركاتهم فوق دركات الكفار ، فإنهم مساكنون الكفار في دار واحدة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Alternatively, the command warns believers to protect themselves from apostasy and regretting their entry into Islam.
rows.anchor: ويجوز أن يأمرهم بالتوقي من الارتداد ، والندم على الدخول في الإسلام

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Alternatively, the address is to people who professed faith only with their tongues, namely hypocrites; the following address to disbelievers supports this reading.
rows.anchor: وأن يكون خطابا للذين آمنوا بألسنتهم وهم المنافقون ؛ ويعضد ذلك قوله تعالى

words: لا تعتذروا اليوم إنما تجزون ما كنتم تعملون
rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The disbelievers are told this when entering the Fire: they have no excuse, or their excuses will not benefit them.
rows.anchor: أي : يقال لهم ذلك عند دخولهم النار لا تعتذروا ، لأنه لا عذر لكم . أو لأنه لا ينفعكم الاعتذار

none: The segment contains only the quoted verse text.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The opening letter is read with clear articulation or assimilation, and with nūn quiescent, open, or kasra-marked, as in Ṣād.
rows.anchor: قرىء : ( ن والقلم ) بالبيان والإدغام ، وبسكون النون وفتحها وكسرها

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The intended ن is the alphabetic letter.
rows.anchor: والمراد هذا الحرف من حروف المعجم

rows.speaker: قيل
rows.claim: The proposed meaning ‘inkpot’ is challenged: neither its status as a common noun nor as a proper name fits the expected case marking and place in the sentence.
rows.anchor: وأما قولهم : هو الدواة فما أدري أهو وضع لغوي أم شرعي

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: If ن meant an inkpot in an oath, a common noun would need genitive and nunation, while a proper name would need its appropriate genitive or fatḥa marking.
rows.anchor: فإن قلت : هو مقسم به وجب إن كان جنسا أن تجره وتنونه

rows.speaker: قيل
rows.claim: The interpretation of ن as a fish, whether one fish or the alleged Bahamut, faces the same grammatical problem as the inkpot interpretation.
rows.anchor: وكذلك التفسير بالحوت : إما أن يراد نون من النينان ، أو يجعل علما للبهموت

rows.speaker: قيل
rows.claim: The proposed interpretations ‘a tablet of light or gold’ and ‘a river in Paradise’ likewise do not fit the syntax.
rows.anchor: والتفسير باللوح من نور أو ذهب ، والنهر في الجنة نحو ذلك

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God swears by the pen to honor it, since its creation and design show great wisdom and its benefits are beyond description.
rows.anchor: وأقسم بالقلم : تعظيما له ، لما في خلقه وتسويته من الدلالة على الحكمة العظيمة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: ما يسطرون can mean the books people write or what the recording angels write; ما can be relative or a verbal noun.
rows.anchor: وما يكتب من كتب وقيل ما يستره الحفظة وما موصولة أو مصدرية

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Alternatively, ‘the pen’ refers to its users, so the pronoun in يسطرون refers to them and means the people of the pen and their written lines, including all writers or the recording angels.
rows.anchor: ويجوز أن يراد بالقلم أصحابه فيكون الضمير في { يسطرون } لهم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The preposition ب attaches to the negated مجنون just as it attaches to عاقل in an affirmative sentence; negation does not change the verb's operation.
rows.anchor: يتعلق بمجنون منفيا ، كما يتعلق بعاقل مثبتا في قولك

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The phrase is in the accusative as a circumstantial phrase: ‘not insane, while blessed by your Lord.’
rows.anchor: ومحله النصب على الحال ، كأنه قال : ما أنت بمجنون منعما عليك بذلك

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The extra ب reinforces the negation and does not prevent مجنون from governing what precedes it.
rows.anchor: ولم تمنع الباء أن يعمل مجنون فيما قبله ، لأنها زائدة لتأكيد النفي

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The verse repudiates the Meccan disbelievers' accusation, arising from enmity and envy, and points to God's gift of sound judgment and courage fitting for prophethood.
rows.anchor: استبعاد ما كان ينسبه إليه كفار مكة عداوة وحسدا ، وأنه من إنعام الله عليه بحصافة العقل والشهامة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The promised reward is for bearing the accusation, enduring its bitterness, and remaining patient.
rows.anchor: على احتمال ذلك وإساغة الغصة فيه والصبر عليه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: غير ممنون may mean unending, as in the description of a reward that is not cut off.
rows.anchor: غير مقطوع كقوله : { عطاء غير مجذوذ }

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Alternatively, the reward is not begrudged because it is earned for the Prophet's work, unlike an unearned favor that can be held over someone.
rows.anchor: أو غير ممنون عليك به ، لأنه ثواب تستوجبه على عملك

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God calls the Prophet's character great because he bore his people's painful treatment, opposed them graciously, and dealt gently with them.
rows.anchor: استعظم خلقه لفرط احتماله الممضات من قومه وحسن مخالفته ومداراته لهم

rows.speaker: قيل
rows.claim: Another view identifies the great character as the conduct God commanded in 7:199: pardon, enjoin what is right, and turn away from the ignorant.
rows.anchor: وقيل : هو الخلق الذي أمره الله تعالى به في قوله تعالى

rows.speaker: عائشة
rows.claim: Aisha told Sa'id ibn Hisham, who asked about the Messenger's character, that it was the Qur'an, then cited al-Mu'minun.
rows.anchor: عن عائشة رضي الله عنها : ( 1217 ) أن سعيد بن هشام سألها عن خلق رسول الله

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: المفتون may mean the insane, because فتن means to afflict with madness or because Arabs attributed madness to jinn's derangement.
rows.anchor: المفتون } المجنون ، لأنه فتن : أي محن بالجنون

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The ب in بأيكم is extra.
rows.anchor: والباء مزيدة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Alternatively, المفتون is a verbal noun like المعقول and المجلود, meaning ‘where is the madness—in the believers or disbelievers?’
rows.anchor: أو المفتون مصدر كالمعقول والمجلود ، أي : بأيكم الجنون

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The wording indirectly targets Abu Jahl, al-Walid ibn al-Mughira, and their peers, asking which group truly deserves the label of insane.
rows.anchor: أي : في أيهما يوجد من يستحق هذا الاسم : وهو تعريض بأبي جهل بن هشام والوليد بن المغيرة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The challenge echoes 54:26's question about who will prove to be the lying, insolent one.
rows.anchor: وهذا كقوله تعالى : { سيعلمون غدا من الكذاب الأشر }

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: A زعيم is a guarantor who takes responsibility for the claim and argues for its soundness, like someone speaking for and managing a group.
rows.anchor: أي قائم به وبالاحتجاج لصحته ، كما يقوم الزعيم المتكلم عن القوم المتكفل بأمورهم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The alleged partners would be people who share and support the disbelievers' claim; they are challenged to produce them if truthful.
rows.anchor: أي ناس يشاركونهم في هذا القول ويوافقونهم عليه ويذهبون مذهبهم فيه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: No one will validate this claim, just as the disbelievers have neither a revealing book, a covenant with God, nor a guarantor for it.
rows.anchor: أن أحدا لا يسلم لهم هذا ولا يساعدهم عليه ، كما أنه لا كتاب لهم ينطق به

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Uncovering the ساق and showing the ankles is a metaphor for a grave crisis; it originates in terror and defeat, when women hike their garments to flee.
rows.anchor: مثل في شدة الأمر وصعوبة الخطب ، وأصله في الروع والهزيمة وتشمير المخدرات عن سوقهن في الهرب

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Hatim's line about war biting and baring its ساق witnesses the metaphor for an intensifying crisis.
rows.anchor: قال حاتم : أخو الحرب إن غضت به الحرب عضها … وإن شمرت عن ساقها الحرب شمرا

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Ibn al-Ruqayyat's line about war displaying the ankles of a noble virgin witnesses the imagery of exposed ankles.
rows.anchor: وقال ابن الرقيات : تذهل الشيخ عن بنيه وتبدي … عن خدام العقيلة العذراء

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The phrase means the crisis becomes severe; no literal uncovering or ساق occurs, just as ‘his hand is tied’ describes a miser without a real hand or bond.
rows.anchor: في معنى : يوم يشتد الأمر ويتفاقم ، ولا كشف ثم ولا ساق ، كماتقول للأقطع الشحيح : يده مغلولة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Those who make the phrase anthropomorphic do so, in the author's view, from narrow understanding and little knowledge of rhetoric.
rows.anchor: وأما من شبه فلضيق عطنه وقلة نظره في علم البيان

rows.speaker: ابن مسعود
rows.claim: A report attributed to Ibn Masud says the Merciful uncovers His ساق, believers prostrate, and hypocrites' backs become rigid, like spits.
rows.anchor: حديث ابن مسعود رضي الله عنه : ( 1220 ) ( يكشف الرحمن عن ساقه ؛ فأما المؤمنون فيخرون سجدا

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The report's ساق means the severity and terror of God's affair on the Day of Resurrection, not a bodily limb.
rows.anchor: ومعناه : يشتد أمر الرحمن ويتفاقم هوله ، وهو الفزع الأكبر يوم القيامة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: A literalist would need a definite form for a specific familiar ساق; the indefinite form signals an obscure, unprecedented terror, as in 54:6.
rows.anchor: للدلالة على أنه أمر مبهم في الشدة منكر خارج عن المألوف

rows.speaker: أبو عبيدة
rows.claim: Abu Ubayda says Muqatil ibn Sulayman anthropomorphized to embodiment, while Jahm ibn Safwan negated attributes to the point of disabling them.
rows.anchor: وعن أبي عبيدة : خرج من خراسان رجلان ، أحدهما : شبه حتى مثل ، وهو مقاتل بن سليمان

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Variants include نكشف with nūn and تكشف with tāʾ, active or passive, with the hour or crisis as subject; each means the crisis grows severe.
rows.anchor: وقرىء : ( يوم نكشف ) بالنون . وتكشف بالتاء على البناء للفاعل والمفعول جميعا

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Another reading has tāʾ with ḍamma and kasra on ش; أكشف means to enter kashf, also said of a man whose upper lip turns up.
rows.anchor: وقرىء : ( تكشف ) بالتاء المضمومة كسر الشين ، من أكشف : إذا دخل في الكشف

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The time adverb is governed by فليأتوا, by an implicit اذكر, or by an omitted clause suppressed to heighten the threat.
rows.anchor: وناصب الظرف : فليأتوا . أو إضمار ( اذكر ) أو يوم يكشف عن ساق كان كيت وكيت

rows.speaker: ابن مسعود
rows.claim: Ibn Masud explains that their backbones become one bone without joints, so they cannot bend when rising or lowering themselves.
rows.anchor: عن ابن مسعود رضي الله عنه : تعقم أصلابهم واحدا ، أي ترد عظاما بلا مفاصل لا تنثني

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: A hadith says their spines remain one rigid piece, meaning a single vertebra.
rows.anchor: وفي الحديث : وتبقى أصلابهم طبقا واحدا ، أي ، فقارة واحدة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: They are summoned to prostrate as rebuke, not legal worship; fused backs prevent them, increasing regret for refusing when sound and able in life.
rows.anchor: لا يدعون إليه تعبدا وتكليفا ، ولكن توبيخا وتعنيفا على تركهم السجود في الدنيا

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: ومن قبله can mean those with Pharaoh or those who preceded him; readings ‘with him’ and ‘in his presence’ support the first sense.
rows.anchor: يريد : ومن عنده من تباعه . وقرىء : ( ومن قبله ) ، أي : ومن تقدمه

rows.speaker: عبد الله
rows.claim: Abd Allah and Ubayy read ‘and those with him’; Abu Musa reads ‘and those in his presence.’
rows.anchor: وتعضد الأولى قراءة عبد الله وأبي ( ومن معه ) وقراءة أبي موسى : ( ومن تلقاءه )

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: المؤتفكات refers to the townspeople of Lot.
rows.anchor: { والمؤتفكات } قرى قوم لوط

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: بالخاطئة means error, or an act or acts involving grave error.
rows.anchor: { بالخاطئة } بالخطأ . أو بالفعلة ، أو الأفعال ذات الخطأ العظيم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: رابية means intense and excessive; the punishment exceeded in severity as their abominations exceeded in vileness; the root denotes increase as in 30:39.
rows.anchor: شديدة زائدة في الشدة ، كما زادت قبائحهم في القبح . يقال : ربا الشيء يربو

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The pronoun may refer to death: he wishes the death that ended his affair had been final, without resurrection.
rows.anchor: الضمير في { ياليتها } للموتة : يقول : يا ليت الموتة التي منها

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Alternatively, it refers to his present state, which he wishes had been the death that finished him, since it is worse than death's agony.
rows.anchor: أو للحالة ، أي : ليت هذه الحالة كانت الموتة التي قضت علي

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: ما أغنى may be a negation or rhetorical question: ‘what benefit did my wealth give me?’
rows.anchor: ما أغنى } نفي أو استفهام على وجه الإنكار ، أي : أي شيء أغنى عني

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: سلطانيه means his power and domination over people; now he is left poor and humiliated.
rows.anchor: ملكي وتسلطى على الناس ، وبقيت فقيرا ذليلا

rows.speaker: ابن عباس
rows.claim: Ibn Abbas says the verse was revealed concerning al-Aswad ibn Abd al-Asad.
rows.anchor: وعن ابن عباس : أنها نزلت في الأسود بن عبد الأشد

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Fanakhusra, called al-Adud, boasted in a poem of his power, then went mad and could speak only this verse.
rows.anchor: وعن فناخسرة الملقب بالعضد ، أنه لما قال : عضد الدولة وابن ركنها … ملك الأملاك غلاب القدر لم يفلح

rows.speaker: ابن عباس
rows.claim: Ibn Abbas glosses the loss of authority as the failure of the argument he used in worldly life.
rows.anchor: وقال ابن عباس : ضلت عني حجتي . ومعناه : بطلت حجتي التي كنت أحتج بها في الدنيا

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Roast him only in the greatest Fire, fitting for a ruler who exalted himself over people.
rows.anchor: ثم لا تصلوه إلا الجحيم ، وهي النار العظمى ، لأنه كان سلطانا يتعظم على الناس

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: صلى النار and صلاة النار are expressions for putting someone into the Fire.
rows.anchor: يقال : صلى النار وصلاة النار

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The chain is wrapped around his body until its links coil around him, leaving him trapped and unable to move.
rows.anchor: أن تلوى على جسده حتى تلتف عليه ألمناؤها ؛ وهو فيما بينها مرهق مضيق عليه لا يقدر على حركة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Seventy cubits expresses great length, as ‘seventy times’ means many times in 9:80; greater length intensifies constriction.
rows.anchor: إرادة الوصف بالطول . كما قال : إن تستغفر لهم سبعين مرة ، يريد : مرات كثيرة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Putting the chain before threading him through it parallels putting the Fire before roasting; the chain is presented as especially terrifying.
rows.anchor: كأنها أفظع من سائر مواضع الإرهاق في الجحيم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Repeated ثم marks the escalation between shackling, roasting, and threading him through the chain, not elapsed time.
rows.anchor: الدلالة على تفاوت ما بين الغل والتصلية بالجحيم ، وما بينها وبين السلك في السلسلة ، لا على تراخي المدة

words: إِنَّهُ كَانَ لَا يُؤْمِنُ بِاللَّهِ الْعَظِيمِ
rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The clause gives the reason for the severe punishment as an explanatory resumption, answering why he receives such torment.
rows.anchor: تعليل على طريق الاستئناف ، وهو أبلغ ؛ كأنه قيل : ما له يعذب هذا العذاب الشديد ؟ فأجيب بذلك

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The verse treats withholding food as grave: it pairs failure to urge feeding with disbelief and condemns lack of encouragement, so actually withholding is worse.
rows.anchor: دليلان قويان على عظم الجرم في حرمان المسكين ، أحدهما : عطفه على الكفر ، وجعله قرينة له

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The poet's line about guests illustrates urging a household to feed people and hastening or chiding them over hospitality.
rows.anchor: وما أحسن قول القائل : إذا نزل الأضياف كان عذورا … على الحي حتى تستقل مراجله

rows.speaker: أبو الدرداء
rows.claim: Abu al-Darda urged his wife to make more broth for the poor, saying faith had removed half the chain and asking whether they would remove the rest.
rows.anchor: وعن أبي الدرداء أنه كان يحض امرأته على تكثير المرق لأجل المساكين

rows.speaker: قيل
rows.claim: Alternatively, the condemned person withheld food from disbelievers, echoing their objection that God could feed whoever He wished.
rows.anchor: وقيل : هو منع الكفار . وقولهم : { أنطعم من لو يشاء الله أطعمه }

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: A حميم is a close relative or friend who would defend and grieve for him, but people avoid and flee him, as in 70:10.
rows.anchor: قريب يدفع عنه ويحزن عليه ، لأنهم يتحامونه ويفرون منه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: غسلين is the wash-off from Hell's inhabitants, including pus and blood flowing from their bodies; its form derives from washing.
rows.anchor: غسالة أهل النار وما يسيل من أبدانهم من الصديد والدم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The خاطئون are sinners who deliberately commit sin; the author identifies them as polytheists, following Ibn Abbas.
rows.anchor: الآثمون أصحاب الخطايا . وخطىء الرجل : إذا تعمد الذنب ، وهم المشركون : عن ابن عباس

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Variants read الخاطيون with hamza changed to yāʾ or الخاطون with the hamza omitted.
rows.anchor: وقرىء : ( الخاطيون ) بإبدال الهمزة ياء ، والخاطون بطرحها

rows.speaker: ابن عباس
rows.claim: Ibn Abbas rejects الخاطون by joking that everyone steps; Abu al-Aswad reports his correction that it is الخاطئون, as الصابئون is correct rather than الصابون.
rows.anchor: وعن ابن عباس : ما الخاطون ؟ كلنا نخطو ، وروى عنه أبو الأسود الدؤلي

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Alternatively, the word describes people who cross from truth into falsehood and transgress God's limits.
rows.anchor: ويجوز أن يراد : الذين يتخطون الحق إلى الباطل ، ويتعدون حدود الله

none: The segment contains only the quoted verse text.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: أوحي is related to وحى by replacing initial wāw with hamza, like أعد and أزن; this substitution is freely allowed when wāw has ḍamma.
rows.anchor: قرىء ( أحى ) وأصله وحي ؛ يقال : أوحي إليه ووحى إليه ، فقلبت الواو همزة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The same substitution appears in 77:11; al-Mazini also permits it with kasra and cites forms such as إشاح and إسادة.
rows.anchor: كما يقال : أعد وأزن { وإذا الرسل أقتت }

rows.speaker: ابن أبي عبلة
rows.claim: Ibn Abi Abla reads وحى, retaining the original form.
rows.anchor: وقرأ ابن أبي عبلة ( وحى ) على الأصل

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Open أنَّهُ because its clause is the subject of أوحي; kasra in إنا سمعنا marks an independent clause quoted after قالوا.
rows.anchor: { أنه استمع } بالفتح ، لأنه فاعل أوحى . وإنا سمعنا : بالكسر ؛ لأنه مبتدأ محكي

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Other clauses attributed to revelation take fatḥa and those spoken by the jinn take kasra, except the last two clauses in verses 18 and 19.
rows.anchor: فما كان من الوحي فتح ، وما كان من قول الجن كسر : وكلهن من قولهم إلا الثنتين الأخريين

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Those who read all clauses with fatḥa coordinate them with the syntactic position of آمنا به, as if the jinn believed the following claims too.
rows.anchor: ومن فتح كلهن فعطفا على محل الجار والمجرور في آمنا به

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: نفر means a group numbering from three to ten.
rows.anchor: جماعة منهم ما بين الثلاثة إلى العشرة

rows.speaker: قيل
rows.claim: It is said that the group belonged to the Shaysaban, the most numerous jinn and the main body of Iblis's troops.
rows.anchor: وقيل : كانوا من الشيصبان ، وهم أكثر الجن عددا وعامة جنود إبليس منهم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: They spoke to their people after returning, as the account in 46:29–30 also says.
rows.anchor: أي : قالوا لقومهم حين رجعوا إليهم ، كقوله : { فلما قضى ولوا إلى قومهم منذرين

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The Qur'an is unlike other books in the beauty of its composition and soundness of meaning, and contains proofs of its inimitability.
rows.anchor: بديعا مباينا لسائر الكتب في حسن نظمه وصحة معانيه ، قائمة فيه دلائل الإعجاز

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: عجب is a verbal noun used in place of عجيب, with emphatic force.
rows.anchor: وعجب مصدر يوضع موضع العجيب . وفيه مبالغة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: الرشد means sound judgment, or specifically monotheism and faith.
rows.anchor: يدعو إلى الصواب . وقيل : إلى توحيد والإيمان

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The pronoun may refer to the Qur'an; believing it entails belief in God's unity and renunciation of association.
rows.anchor: والضمير في { به } للقرآن ؛ ولما كان الإيمان به إيمانا بالله وبوحدانيته وبراءة من الشرك

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Alternatively, the pronoun refers to God, explained by the jinn's phrase ‘our Lord.’
rows.anchor: ويجوز أن يكون الضمير لله عز وجل ؛ لأن قوله : { بربنا } يفسره

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: جد ربنا means God's greatness, from the expression that someone became great in another's eyes; Umar's report uses the same word for being esteemed.
rows.anchor: عظمته من قولك : جد فلان في عيني ، أي : عظم . وفي حديث عمر رضي الله عنه

rows.speaker: عمر
rows.claim: Umar says that a man among them who recited al-Baqara and Al Imran became esteemed among them.
rows.anchor: وفي حديث عمر رضي الله عنه : كان الرجل منا إذا قرأ البقرة وآل عمران جد فينا

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Alternatively, جد means God's rule, sovereignty, or wealth, by analogy with good fortune marking kings and the wealthy.
rows.anchor: أو ملكه وسلطانه أو غناه ، استعارة من الجد الذي هو الدولة والبخت

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: A reading جدا ربنا makes جدا a specification; جد ربنا with kasra on jīm means the truth of God's lordship and divinity, excluding spouse and child.
rows.anchor: وقرىء ( جدا ربنا ) على التمييز وجد ربنا ، بالكسر : أي صدق ربوبيته

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The statement that God has taken neither spouse nor child explains the preceding description of His greatness, sovereignty, or divinity.
rows.anchor: وقوله : { ما اتخذ صاحبة ولا ولدا } بيان لذلك

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: سفيهنا may refer to Iblis, cursed by God, or to another rebellious jinn.
rows.anchor: سفيههم : إبليس لعنه الله أو غيره من مردة الجن

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: شطط means exceeding bounds in injustice or elsewhere; أشط في السوم means to set an excessive price.
rows.anchor: والشطط : مجاوزة الحد في الظلم وغيره . ومنه : أشط في السوم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Attributing spouse and child to God is an extreme falsehood; the jinn had trusted neither humans nor jinn would lie about God until the Qur'an exposed their fabrication.
rows.anchor: وكان في ظننا أن أحدا من الثقلين لن يكذب على الله ولن يفترى عليه ما ليس بحق

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: كَذِبًا means a false statement, or is an accusative verbal noun because lying is a kind of speech.
rows.anchor: قولا كذبا ، أي : مكذوبا فيه . أو نصب نصب المصدر لأن الكذب نوع من القول

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: With the reading أن لن تقول, كذبا substitutes for تقولا rather than describing it, since fabrication is necessarily a lie.
rows.anchor: ومن قرأ ( أن لن تقول ) وضع كذبا موضع تقولا ، ولم يجعله صفة

none: The segment contains only the quoted verse text.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: وأن المساجد may be part of the revelation, or the reason for the command not to invoke anyone alongside God in mosques.
rows.anchor: { وأن المساجد } من جملة الموحى . وقيل معناه : ولأن المساجد

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: No one may be invoked alongside God in mosques because they belong to Him exclusively and are devoted to His worship.
rows.anchor: أي : فلا تدعوا { مع الله أحدا } في المساجد ، لأنها لله خاصة ولعبادته

rows.speaker: الحسن
rows.claim: Al-Hasan says the mosques mean the whole earth, made a place of prostration for the Prophet.
rows.anchor: وعن الحسن : يعني الأرض كلها ؛ لأنها جعلت للنبي صلى الله عليه وسلم مسجدا

rows.speaker: قيل
rows.claim: Another view identifies the mosques as the Sacred Mosque, the qibla toward which other mosques face.
rows.anchor: وقيل : المراد بها المسجد الحرام ، لأنه قبلة المساجد

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The author links this to 2:114, which condemns preventing God's name from being mentioned in His mosques.
rows.anchor: ومنه قوله تعالى : { ومن أظلم ممن منع مساجد الله أن يذكر فيها اسمه }

rows.speaker: قتادة
rows.claim: Qatada says Jews and Christians associated partners with God in their synagogues and churches, so Muslims were commanded to direct invocation to God alone in mosques.
rows.anchor: وعن قتادة : كان اليهود والنصارى إذا دخلوا بيعهم وكنائسهم أشركوا بالله

rows.speaker: قيل
rows.claim: Another interpretation takes the mosques to mean the seven bodily parts used in prostration.
rows.anchor: وقيل : المساجد أعضاء السجود السبعة

rows.speaker: رسول الله
rows.claim: The Prophet says he was commanded to prostrate on seven limbs: forehead, nose, hands, knees, and feet.
rows.anchor: قال رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم : ( 1235 ) ( أمرت أن أسجد على سبعة آراب : وهي الجبهة

rows.speaker: قيل
rows.claim: Another view treats masājid as the plural of masjid, meaning prostration itself.
rows.anchor: وقيل : هي جمع مسجد وهو السجود

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The Prophet says this to those who gathered against him.
rows.anchor: ( قال ) للمتظاهرين عليه

words: إِنَّمَآ أَدْعُوا رَبِّى وَلَآ أُشْرِكُ بِهِۦٓ أَحَدًا
rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: One explanation is that the Prophet says he does nothing strange, only worships his Lord alone, and that this does not justify their united hostility.
rows.anchor: يريد : ما أتيتكم بأمر منكر ، إنما أعبد ربي وحده

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Alternatively, he says this to jinn gathered in wonder: worshiping and worshiping God alone is not strange; what is strange is invoking someone beside God and making Him a partner.
rows.anchor: أو قال للجن عند ازدحامهم متعجبين : ليس ما ترون من عبادتي الله ورفضي الإشراك به بأمر يتعجب منه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Alternatively, the words are spoken by the jinn to their people as a report of what the Messenger said.
rows.anchor: أو قال الجن لقومهم ذلك حكاية عن رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم

rows.speaker: أبي
rows.claim: Ubayy reads غيا ولا رشدا; on this reading, الضر may mean misguidance.
rows.anchor: ويدل عليه قراءة أبي ( غيا ولا رشدا )

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The Prophet may say he cannot harm or benefit people, since God alone causes harm and benefit; alternatively, he cannot compel them to error or guidance, which only God can do.
rows.anchor: والمعنى لا أستطيع أن أضركم وأن أنفعكم ، إنما الضار والنافع الله

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: إلا بلاغا is an exception from the preceding denial: the Prophet possesses only the ability to convey what comes from God.
rows.anchor: استثناء منه . أي لا أملك إلا بلاغا من الله

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: ملتحد means refuge, originally an entry-place from لحد; it can also mean an escape or way around.
rows.anchor: والملتحد الملتجأ ، وأصله المدخل ، من اللحد . وقيل : محيصا ومعدلا

rows.speaker: قيل
rows.claim: Another parsing makes بلاغا an appositive of ملتحدا: the only refuge is to convey God's message.
rows.anchor: وقيل : ( بلاغا ) بدل من { ملتحدا } أي : لن أجد من دونه منجى إلا أن أبلغ عنه

rows.speaker: قيل
rows.claim: Alternatively, إلا means أن لا, giving the sense ‘not to convey a message,’ as in إن لا قياما فقعودا.
rows.anchor: وقيل : { إلا } هي ( أن لا ) ومعناه : أن لا أبلغ بلاغا

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: ورسالاته coordinates with بلاغا: the Prophet has no power except to convey God's messages without addition or omission.
rows.anchor: وأن أبلغ رسالاته التي أرسلني بها من غير زيادة ولا نقصان

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The parenthetical clause reinforces the Prophet's lack of power: if God wills illness, death, or another harm, no one can protect him or provide refuge.
rows.anchor: جملة معترضة اعترض بها لتأكيد نفي الاستطاعة عن نفسه وبيان عجزه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: A reading has قال لا أملك, spoken by the Prophet to polytheists or jinn, or recounted by the jinn to their people.
rows.anchor: وقرىء ( قال لا أملك ) أي قال عبد الله للمشركين أو للجن . ويجوز أن يكون من حكاية الجن لقومهم
